column1: # Texture ink colours that signal a diagnostic mineral.
# Used by the `ink` column of lith_textures.tsv; `auto` there means "tint of
# this lithology's own fill" and is the default for everything else.
# Muted on purpose - these sit ON TOP of an already-coloured polygon, so a
# saturated ink fights the fill instead of reading as mineralogy.
